IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Online Form 2026 (6715 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the post of Probationary Officer / Management Trainee. This recruitment has been issued for 6715 posts. The online application process for IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Recruitment 2026 has started on 01 July 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 21 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Edit Application Window : 31 July 2026
  • PET Admit Card  (SC/ ST) : August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : August 2026
  • Pre Exam Admit Card : August 2026
  • Pre Result : September 2026
  • Mains Admit Card: September 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : October 2026
  • Mains Result : November 2026
  • Mains Score Card : November 2026
  • Personality Test : November 2026
  • Interview Letter : November 2026
  • Interview Date : November/ December 2026
  • Final Result : January 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Application Correction Charge : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
